items.title: When Text Becomes Tradable: Financial-domain Language Models and the Asymmetric Absorption of News in Agricultural Futures Markets
items.claim: Agricultural futures returns respond to media news only via finance-domain LLM embeddings, not general ones.

items.title: Accurate but Correlated: Common AI Forecast Errors & Endogenous Market Volatility
items.claim: Equicorrelated AI forecast errors create aggregate variance floors independent of model accuracy or institution count.

items.title: Contingent Winners: Forecast Scale and Model Rankings in Volatility Forecasting
items.claim: Volatility forecast model rankings flip between GARCH and deep learning depending on regime, seed, and evaluation loss.

items.title: Stranded Credentials: How A Skill-Signaling Market Absorbed Generative AI
items.claim: Upload medals lost 82% signaling value despite fresh medals retaining power, suggesting format-specific credential decay during the AI era.

items.title: Do Banks Really Know What They Get From AI?
items.claim: Major banks claim AI cost savings but withhold spend data, making public verification impossible.

items.title: The Clock of Regimes: An Operator-Theoretic Early-Warning System for Financial Fragility
items.claim: Operator-theoretic tail diagnostics detected maximum portfolio stress weeks before leveraged concentration became forced liquidation.
